from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Judgment(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document's key extractable facts."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The actual title of the judgment document as written (e.g. '《判决文书 1》')")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action (案由) cited in the document (e.g. '财产损害赔偿纠纷')")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the court or administrative body involved")
    parties: list[str] | None = Field(description="Names of the parties involved in the dispute (Plaintiff/Defendant)")
    dispute_focus: str | None = Field(description="A short description of the core dispute or key facts (e.g. 'labor contract termination', 'ship repair payment')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[Judgment]
